ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels dominate approximately 92% of the visible ventral surface, with low-intensity (black) pixels restricted to the peripheral trailing edge and specific linear disruptions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central contiguous high-intensity region spanning both lobes; low-intensity contiguous banding along the trailing edge boundary; high-contrast vertical linear streaks (rake marks) mapping across the mid-sections of both left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 140 degrees and a vertical pixel depth representing roughly 12% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude peaks and valleys (2-4 pixel amplitude) along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased irregularity and deeper serrations localized near the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve from the median notch to the mid-lobe, transitioning to a slight concavity toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of low-intensity, roughly circular pixel groups localized at the extreme left distal tip; minor dark focal spots visible near the median notch.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Densely mapped vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) ranging from 10 to 100 pixels in length, crossing the ventral high-intensity pigmentation on both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive vertical rake marks across both lobes; dark encrustation or physical trauma evidence at the left fluke tip.
other_distinctive_markers: The density and alignment of the vertical linear markings create a unique 'pinstripe' texture across the otherwise uniform white fluke surface.
